# 共享存量上的汲取：每种组合都在存量之内，当且仅当总和在内 / Draws on one shared stock: every combination fits exactly when the total does

## 主张 Claim

前 n 项以自然数给出的汲取中，每一种选取都在存量之内，当且仅当它们的总和在存量之内。 / Of the first n draws, given as natural numbers, every selection fits within the stock exactly when their total does.

Canonical source: [CorrectionDependence.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/meta-attractor/CorrectionDependence.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 汲取是可相加的自然数；存量是它们共同汲取的同一个量。 / The draws are natural numbers that add; the stock is the one quantity they all draw on.

在源模型中，每项汲取是一项活动无过渡损失地停止所需的工作，存量是为此留出的部分。这些数不是一般的价值度量；与实际活动和存量的对应需另行核实。 / In the source model, each draw is the work an activity needs to stop without its transition loss, and the stock is what is set aside for that work. The numbers are not a general measure of value; their correspondence to actual activities and stocks needs separate evidence.

每项单独在内不推出共同在内：两项各为二单位的汲取可以竞争同一个二单位的存量。 / Each draw fitting alone does not make them fit together: two draws of two units each can compete for one stock of two.
